name: capsaicin
uses: Uses For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with arthritis, simple backache, strains, sprains and bruises.
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a doctor if ●the condition gets worse ●symptoms last more than 7 days, or clear up and return within a few days ●severe burning, irritation or redness occurs ●pain, swelling or blistering develops at the application site If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
